name: hcportal_reactToChatMessage
description: Portal twin of hcapp_reactToChatMessage (E9.F1.S22, 2026-09-30): adds or removes the portal user's emoji reaction on a chat message. The rule and the write are HC6.nonApi_reactToChatMessage, shared with the app and the web; the portal sends no push (the chat refreshes on its next fetch). Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth, standard token (no param string); who may react is decided inside nonApi_reactToChatMessage (outcome 3 = not allowed in that chat).

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message reacted to. Required: NULL returns 'messageId and reaction are required'.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row. Success = 1 when nonApi_reactToChatMessage reports outcome 1. Success = 0 on auth failure, missing parameters, outcome 3 ('You can''t react in that chat.'), outcome 4 ('That reaction isn''t available.'), any other outcome ('That message is no longer in the chat.'), or from the CATCH block (HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

columns.name: reactions
columns.description: The message's reactions JSON after the change (NULL when none, and on every error path).

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_reactToChatMessage — UPDATE HC.EventMessage reactions JSON for the message
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
